summary: The Screen Space Overlay equivalent of FakeLight, working in screen pixels.
overview: A separate tool rather than a mode of the 3D FakeLight, because overlay UI has no 3D world position to sample from at all. It publishes real SCREEN-PIXEL coordinates into a shared global array each frame, using the same technique the 3D version uses in world space.
useCases: A glow that appears to light UI panels and icons.
A torch or scanner effect over a menu.
Lighting flat UI without moving it into world space.

params.tuning: In PIXELS, not world units — so the same value covers different amounts of UI at different resolutions.

gotchas.title: Overlay only
gotchas.body: A Screen Space Camera or World Space canvas has a real position, so the 3D FakeLight applies there instead. Mixing them up is the usual reason nothing lights.
